confidentUnsupported.evidence: hedged as 'likely points to a faulty radiant element or its control switch' - not asserted as certain

blockingLoop.evidence: Three near-identical replies: 'To help identify the correct replacement part for that back right ring, I'll need the full model number of your Zanussi hob' after the customer twice said they only have 'ZHRN'

rationale: The assistant correctly narrowed to a zone-specific fault (element or control/board) and did not fabricate or give unsafe instructions, but it never used the customer's key clues (previous slowness, no glow, display shows level) to progress, never asked about residual heat or prior slow heating, and never escalated to an engineer to test element vs board. Instead it repeated the same model-number request three times after the customer explicitly said they could not read the rest, and its one 'new' check (put a pan on and turn it on) was redundant. The homeowner left with no actionable next step.
